text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our journey to the Classics begins this
year. We
decide to meet up to make our
New Year's
resolutions, but...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Do I really have to make a resolution,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Well...
choice_data_list: そういう気分じゃない？
choice_data_list_en: Not in the mood for that?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Resolutions are something you make
when you
wanna work hard or
accomplish something, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
But I've only come this far 'cause I've
already
been working as hard as I can.
And I have to keep
it up if I wanna get
to the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I'll be racing against other racers that
debuted in
the same year as me though.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...So nothing's really changing.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I'll end up getting bored
again...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
choice_data_list: じゃあレース以外だとどう？
choice_data_list_en: Then how about outside of races?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Is it okay for me to do that?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
choice_data_list: いいよ、“新年の”抱負だから

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
W-well... In that case, I wanna go on lots
of dates!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And I wanna learn lots of grown-up
things from
you!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, it's perfect! You're the one who
told me I
could make any resolution! ☆
choice_data_list_en: Oh, so that's how it is~

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So that's it, I've made my decision! My
resolution
will be to go on lots of dates!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Haha. I love you, Trainer. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun's mood does a total
one-eighty,
and a smile spreads across
her face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think seeing things from a different
perspective
will be good for her. Maybe
one day, she'll have a
truly
heart-fluttering experience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And for that reason...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Are you serious?!
choice_data_list: 早速デートに行こうか！
choice_data_list_en: Shall we head out on our date right away?
Let's head out on our date right away!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yay! Let's go!
choice_data_list: やりたいことを叶えにいこう！
choice_data_list_en: Let's go make what you want to do a reality!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! A New Year's date! ☆ Where
should we
go?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oooh, great idea!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
But there's no time to waste! ♪ Let's go
buy some
lucky bags! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! ♪ Let's keep this date going until
the sun
goes down. ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no sign that this shopping trip
will end
before sunset...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yay! ☆ I'll have to tell Fuji I won't be
going home
tonight. ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Of course, even I know when to put my
foot
down. I wrap things up and escort
Mayano Top
Gun back to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: New Year's food... Like a lunch date?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! Anything's fun when I'm
with you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Is it really okay for me to be here? This
place has
got serious grown-up vibes...

text_block_list.name: Japanese Restaurant Hostess
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, aren't you a cutie. Come on
inside and
take a seat.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Um... Okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I enjoy my lunch date with a nervous
Mayano Top
Gun.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Great idea! ♪ It's perfect for New
Year's. ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Maya comes in for the landing! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wait a second. What are you gonna pray
for?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey, that's no fun! Spill it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I pray that Mayano Top
Gun's wishes
may one day be fulfilled.
